versions.changelog:
Initial release of Ergo Desk Calibrator — ergonomic setup made personal.

- Computes optimal chair, desk, and monitor heights from your height using anthropometric proportions.
- Checks any monitor size for correct height and distance; flags need for risers/lowering.
- Provides guidance for laptop setups (external keyboard/riser protocol).
- Maps pain symptoms (neck/shoulder/wrist/eye/back) to likely workstation causes with fix suggestions.
- Includes a 12-point posture self-audit and the 20-20-20 rule for eye health.
- Works offline, requires only Python standard library.
